instances.name: InventoryService
instances.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Config = require(script.Parent.InventoryConfig)
local playerData = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
playerData:GetAsync("42")
playerData:SetAsync("42", {})
CollectionService:GetTagged("Enemy")
script:GetAttribute("Version")
script:SetAttribute("Version", 1)
ReplicatedStorage.Purchase:FireServer()
ReplicatedStorage.Purchase.OnServerEvent:Connect(function() end)
